name: text_to_music
description: Use for a simple new music request when the user does not need a specialized Mureka workflow. Creates a song when lyrics are supplied, otherwise an instrumental.

name: create_instrumental
description: Use when the user needs original background music without vocals. Returns a queued task id; follow with query_music_task until terminal.

name: create_song
description: Use when the user already has lyrics and wants a fully produced vocal song. Returns a queued task id; follow with query_music_task until terminal.

name: create_song_from_prompt
description: Use when the user wants a complete vocal song from a concept but has no finished lyrics. Returns a queued task id; follow with query_music_task until terminal.

name: generate_lyrics
description: Use when the deliverable is song lyrics or when lyrics are needed before create_song. It produces text, not audio.

name: extend_lyrics
description: Use when existing lyrics need another verse, chorus, bridge, or continuation. It produces revised text, not audio.

name: query_music_task
description: Use only after a Mureka creation or editing tool returned a task id. Poll once per call until succeeded, failed, cancelled, or dry_run; request download on the final poll.

name: get_music_task
description: Alias for query_music_task. Use only to check an existing Mureka task id; it does not start new music generation.

name: extend_song
description: Use when an existing song or uploaded audio should continue beyond a specified time. Requires lyrics for the extension and a song or upload id.

name: region_edit_song
description: Use when only a specific time range of an existing song should be replaced. Requires start/end times plus a song or upload id.

name: remix_song
description: Use when an existing song or uploaded audio should be reinterpreted with a new style or production prompt while keeping it as the source.

name: stem_song
description: Use when the user needs an existing song separated into stems such as vocals and instrumental parts. Requires a song or upload id.

name: recognize_song
description: Use to identify or analyze what song is present in uploaded audio or an audio URL. It does not generate or edit music.

name: describe_song
description: Use to obtain a musical description of an existing Mureka song or uploaded audio for planning, tagging, or a later remix.

name: transcribe_song
description: Use to extract sung words or lyrics from an existing Mureka song or uploaded audio. It does not create new audio.

name: vocal_clone
description: Use only when the user explicitly wants a reusable vocal model made from an uploaded voice sample. Requires an upload id.

name: generate_track
description: Use to add or regenerate a specific musical track for an existing song, such as drums or bass. Requires a track type and a song or upload id.

name: generate_soundtrack
description: Use when the user needs music synchronized to an uploaded media file or a specified time range. Use create_instrumental for standalone background music.

name: generate_lyrics_video
description: Use when the user wants a lyric video from an existing Mureka song or uploaded audio. It is not the general multi-clip video editor.

name: upload_file
description: Use only when another Mureka operation requires an upload id and the source bytes are available as base64. It does not analyze or generate media by itself.

purpose.description: Allowed values: reference, melody, instrumental, voice, audio, remix, soundtrack, lyrics-video.

name: create_speech
description: Use when the user needs spoken narration or voiceover from text. Use song tools for singing and music tools for instrumental audio.

name: create_podcast
description: Use when the user wants a spoken podcast-style audio program from a script. Use create_speech for a single narration passage.

name: query_billing
description: Use only when the user explicitly asks about Mureka account billing or quota. It does not estimate Renderhaus-wide generation cost.

name: list_mureka_models
description: Use only when Mureka model selection or availability is relevant; it does not generate audio. Prefer the configured default for ordinary requests.
